get.description:
Server-Sent Events: `state` when the job is queued or starts, `progress` while it runs (fraction, step, ETA),
then `done`, `error` or `cancelled` with the whole job, and the stream ends (or `unauthorized` when the session
ends meanwhile, checked every 15 s). An event's id is the job's version
(+1 at every change of its row), so a reconnect with Last-Event-ID gets the job's latest state only if it changed
since; the last event always comes.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: null for the system (a command, a migration, a schedule)

before_hash.title: Before Hash
before_hash.description: sha256 of the state before the write, when there was one

next.title: Next
next.description: the `before` of the next page, or null on the last one

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: the loss went beyond the VaR

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: cvc (a call on the basket against calls on the members) or pvp (puts)

price.title: Price
price.description: long the basket, short the members: in % of notional, undiscounted

rho.title: Rho
rho.description: the average correlation the quote was simulated with

implied_rho.title: Implied Rho
implied_rho.description: the flat correlation that gives the basket's price

BasketQuote.title: BasketQuote
BasketQuote.description: One pseudo-quote: the option on the basket against the same options on its members, at one year.

BasketQuotes.title: BasketQuotes
BasketQuotes.description: The latest day's CvC and PvP pseudo-quotes (origin synthetic: no broker level); `day` is null without any.

greeks.title: Greeks
greeks.description: delta and vega by name, on by default for the book

vol_shift.title: Vol Shift
vol_shift.description: s of the shifted vega, in vol: 0 moves the wings in proportion

feller.title: Feller
feller.description: 2 kappa theta / xi^2: at least 1 keeps the variance positive

arbitrage.title: Arbitrage
arbitrage.description: the surface's butterfly and calendar checks

slv.title: Slv
slv.description: mix and particles of the leverage

state.title: State
state.description: cancelled at once when it was queued; running until it stops at its next batch

CostDefaults.title: CostDefaults
CostDefaults.description: The desk's cost table by group of underlyings and size band, its versions and the starting values.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: group of underlyings -> size bands -> lines (structured/defaults)

CostTier.title: CostTier
CostTier.description: One size band of a group: up to `max_notional`, each field's value (fractions, as the sheet's costs).

coupon_bp.title: Coupon Bp
coupon_bp.description: what it costs the coupon, bp per annum

DeskLine.title: DeskLine
DeskLine.description: One line of the desk price: a provision, a bump, a digital or an interaction, on the base's random numbers.

coupon_base.title: Coupon Base
coupon_base.description: the coupon before the desk's lines (fraction per annum)

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: the engine asked for: auto, gpu, cpu or numpy

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.description: the engine that runs: gpu, cpu or numpy

reserve.title: Reserve
reserve.description: the reserve still held at the close

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: what each name's market was made of (origins only)

trades.title: Trades
trades.description: the trades alive that day: id, version, status

EodRun.title: EodRun
EodRun.description: A stored EOD run: the book's value and Greeks at a day's close, on that day's market from the lake.

Estimate.description: every Monte Carlo number of a job result: its value and its standard error (null when the library gives none)

maturities.title: Maturities
maturities.description: target maturities in years: the closest expiry to each is fitted

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: spread: each quote by the inverse of its bid-ask in vol (the default); equal: alike

moneyness.title: Moneyness
moneyness.description: (lo, hi) of K/F: only the quotes inside are fitted

max_rel_spread.title: Max Rel Spread
max_rel_spread.description: quotes wider than this, relative to mid, are dropped

n_strikes_heston.title: N Strikes Heston
n_strikes_heston.description: strikes per maturity in Heston's fit

fixings.title: Fixings
fixings.description: name -> date -> level at the model's scale (100)

underlying.title: Underlying
underlying.description: default: the underlying of the market in use

text.title: Text
text.description: pasted or CSV dates and levels

real_spot.title: Real Spot
real_spot.description: the real spot of the market's model level 100

path.title: Path
path.description: section.field, the key of `bounds` and of a problem's `errors[].field`

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: choice, number, int, date, bool, names

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: what one unit of the value is: per annum, of initial, bp, vol points, months...

utilization.title: Utilization
utilization.description: fraction of the time the card was busy

GpuState.title: GpuState
GpuState.description: A card as `nvidia-smi` saw it at the worker's last heartbeat.

Headline.title: Headline
Headline.description:
A quote's headline: what it solved (a coupon, a swap's strike in vol points, a price) as `{kind, value, se, unit,
label}`; kind is coupon, strike or upfront.

last.title: Last
last.description: the last close in the lake

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: fraction done, while running and at the end

eta.title: Eta
eta.description: seconds left, estimated from the progress so far (null early on)

elapsed.title: Elapsed
elapsed.description: seconds since the job started (0 while queued)

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: the Monte Carlo engine the worker ran it on

version.title: Version
version.description: +1 at every change: the id of its SSE events

job_id.title: Job Id

reused.title: Reused

JobResult.title: JobResult

JobRow.title: JobRow

next.title: Next

everywhere.title: Everywhere

spot.title: Spot

atm_vols.title: Atm Vols

zero_rates.title: Zero Rates

carry.title: Carry
